Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
Does the +2 damage from mass reality counts to concelead weapon requirements?

I found:
A weapon's "current damage" is the amount of damage that it would inflict if used as a strike against a generic opponent. [RTR 19980623]
Strength or other bonus from the minion are not counted. [LSJ 20020821]

Concealed Weapon
Only usable before range is determined.
This minion equips with a non-unique weapon card from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). The weapon cannot cost 3 or more pool or inflict (with a regular strike) aggravated damage or 4 or more damage.

Mass Reality
Put this card in play. Weapons possessed by minions you control inflict +1 damage each strike. Any minion may burn this card as a Ⓓ action.
As above, but the weapons inflict +2 damage each strike.

I am death.
Paul Kersey, Death Wish
